title: Tempest Lightning Proximity Alert
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=weatherflow:obs
| stats min(lightning_distance_km) as nearest_lightning_km, count(eval(lightning_distance_km<10)) as close_strikes by station
| where close_strikes>0
| sort nearest_lightning_km
description: Uses Tempest station telemetry telemetry to monitor nearest lightning strikes seen by the home weather station in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for storm cells that are approaching too closely, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tempest station telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Station table of nearest strike distance and close-strike count.
grandmaExplanation: It flags nearest lightning strikes seen by the home weather station so you can spot storm cells that are approaching too closely before it becomes annoying.
